Excelente puesto en el mercado de Federico Grases de Madrid. El puesto está ubicado en planta calle en uno de los mercados que mejor funcionan en la ciudad de Madrid, ubicación en uno de los espacios con mayor paso de gente, al ser un puesto de esquina tiene mucha visibilidad.

inv.desc_en:
Excellent stall in the Federico Grases market in Madrid. The stall is located on the street level in one of the best-functioning markets in the city of Madrid, located in one of the spaces with the most traffic, being a corner stall it has a lot of visibility.
Suitable for any type of activity; fruit shop, fish shop, butcher shop, poultry shop, etc.
Take the opportunity to rent one of the best stalls in the Federico Grases market for the development of a commercial activity in a market with a large influx of customers.
